name: xAI
tagline: Elon Musk's frontier lab — from Colossus to a SpaceX merger at US$250B in under three years
shortSummary: xAI is Elon Musk's frontier lab behind the Grok model family and the Colossus supercomputer, founded in 2023.

facts.label: Founders
facts.value: Elon Musk + 11 AI researchers (incl. Igor Babuschkin, departed)

facts.label: Sector
facts.value: Frontier foundation models + AI infrastructure (Grok; Colossus)

facts.label: Key product
facts.value: Grok assistant; Colossus training cluster (1M+ H100-equivalents)

facts.label: Outcome
facts.value: Acquired by SpaceX for US$250B all-stock (Feb 2026); combined ~US$1.75T after SpaceX IPO (Jun 2026)

rounds.label: Seed
rounds.note: Early outside funding reported to the SEC (Form D) in December 2023, targeting a US$1B round.

rounds.label: Series B
rounds.note: A strategic syndicate of tier-one VCs plus sovereign wealth.

rounds.label: Series C
rounds.note: Doubled the valuation to US$50B in seven months.

rounds.label: X Corp Acquisition
rounds.note: xAI acquired X Corp in an all-stock deal, valuing xAI at US$80B and X at US$33B — merging the AI lab with the social platform for data and distribution.

rounds.label: Debt & Equity Package
rounds.note: US$5B debt arranged by Morgan Stanley plus ~US$5B strategic equity for the Colossus compute buildout, following a US$300M secondary at US$113B earlier in 2025.

rounds.label: Series D
rounds.note: Reported by CNBC/Bloomberg at a US$200B valuation with Valor, QIA and Kingdom Holding among named participants (Musk publicly disputed the report at the time; the close was nevertheless corroborated by multiple outlets). Labeled Reported because xAI did not announce it on its own news feed under that name.

rounds.label: Series E
rounds.note: Upsized from a US$15B target. Nvidia and Cisco joined as strategic investors; Tesla committed ~US$2B subject to regulatory approval; Saudi HUMAIN invested US$3B.

rounds.label: SpaceX Acquisition
rounds.note: SpaceX acquired xAI in an all-stock transaction valuing xAI at US$250B (SpaceX at ~US$1T); xAI investors received 0.1433 SpaceX shares per xAI share. After SpaceX's June 2026 IPO the combined company was valued at roughly US$1.75T.

sections.heading: Colossus as the Moat
sections.body: xAI's defining asset is not Grok but Colossus — a Memphis training cluster built at record speed to 1M+ H100-equivalent GPUs. The capital raises of 2024–2026 map directly to this hardware buildout: each round bought more GPUs, and the July 2025 US$10B package plus an off-balance-sheet US$20B GPU-leasing SPV (Nvidia + asset managers, October 2025) extended the model without diluting equity.

sections.heading: Merging the Lab With the Platform
sections.body: The March 2025 all-stock acquisition of X (xAI at US$80B) gave Grok exclusive access to X's real-time data and distribution. The SpaceX merger eleven months later (US$250B) folded the lab into Musk's broader aerospace-and-compute empire, ending xAI's life as an independent company.

sections.heading: Valuation Velocity and Contested Rounds
sections.body: From US$5B (December 2023) to US$250B (February 2026) is roughly a 50x expansion in 26 months — the fastest valuation arc in the frontier-lab set. It came with unusual noise: Musk publicly called the September 2025 Series D report 'fake news' before its close was corroborated, and Tesla's US$2B Series E commitment remained subject to shareholder approval.

sections.heading: From Lab to Subsidiary
sections.body: The February 2026 SpaceX acquisition at US$250B was effectively an exit for xAI's outside investors, who swapped into SpaceX equity. Post-SpaceX-IPO (June 2026), the combined entity's ~US$1.75T valuation made the xAI round history a prologue to the Musk capital machine rather than a standalone story.
